title: How to get rosacea treated by a dermatologist through your AI
summary: Rosacea treatment online: a FutureClinic doctor reads your case by message for a $40 visit. Compare Curology and Honeydew, creams, pills and AI steps.
body_markdown:
## How does FutureClinic compare with Honeydew and Curology?


Prices and features were checked as of October 2026.


Feature Honeydew Curology FutureClinic


**Who treats you** "licensed dermatologists, dermatology physician assistants, or dermatology nurse practitioners" "board-certified physician, physician assistant, or nurse practitioner" Physicians only (MD, DO or MBBS), never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant


**What you pay (as of October 2026)** First consult free; $39/mo (3-mo min), $129/4 mos, $299/yr; Accutane $64/mo, $229/4 mos, $50/mo annual; medicine extra $5.45 trial shipping, then $29.95/mo ($59.90/60 days) with formula; extra consults $10 $40 for best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's price, typically $20 to $100; optional memberships typically $25 to $100/mo


**Subscription required?** Yes ($26 fee before 3-month minimum) Yes online ($24.97 Walmart kit covers 60 days) No subscription required; optional memberships, cancel any time


**Where the medicine comes from** Local or mail pharmacies and compounded formulas Personalized Skin Solutions, Inc. for topicals; local pharmacy or InnovaScript for pills The pharmacy you choose, including local and mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door


**What else the doctor can help with** Medical dermatology only Acne, rosacea, aging, some hair loss, weight; no eczema or psoriasis Other problems in their specialty, or see doctors in more than 60 specialties where every FutureClinic doctor you see works from your one medical record


**How you reach them** Website, photos, messaging, video when needed; no AI app Website, photos, messaging; no video or AI app By message on futureclinic.com or from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, Meta Muse and Instinct


**What you get back** Plan and monthly check-ins; reply time not stated Formula and message, typical reply in 2 to 3 days Plan and Human Signature video or voice note, typically within a few hours, almost always the same day or the next


If you want what these companies sell beyond the doctor, each is a strong option.[Curology](https://support.curology.com/en_us/pricing-and-products-BJOLQnd2O) fits if you want its custom compounded formula bundled into a shipment at $29.95 a month ($59.90 every 60 days after a $5.45 trial, as of October 2026), or live outside FutureClinic's states.[Honeydew](https://www.honeydew.com/pricing) fits if you want video visits when needed or a skin-only membership across all 50 states ($39 a month with a 3-month minimum or $299 a year, as of October 2026). Curology states (updated January 2026) it will "never prescribe you a custom skincare treatment using an algorithm, AI", while Honeydew states nothing on AI in care.


The question worth asking before you sign up is simple: do you actually want a custom-bottle shipment or a skin-only membership with its ongoing commitments, or did you want a doctor of your own to evaluate your skin and prescribe what fits?


If all you wanted was an expert doctor directly, FutureClinic gives you that with nothing attached. Every clinician is a physician (MD, DO or MBBS), never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant, as we believe people's health deserves expert-level care. FutureClinic sells no medicine and your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test, so they can prescribe any brand or generic medicine to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door.


With no subscription needed, one $40 visit (or a chosen doctor's price, typically $20 to $100) lets your doctor prescribe several months of a stable medicine when safe, instead of requiring a subscription for refills. At[Cost Plus Drugs](https://api.costplusdrugs.com/pricelist/cpd) as of October 2026, metronidazole 0.75% gel (45 g) is $10.05 before shipping ($15.30 shipped), and on[GoodRx](https://www.goodrx.com/azelaic-acid) as of October 2026, generic azelaic acid 15% gel (50 g) is $36.47. Pharmacy insurance may cover your medicine, and FutureClinic helps with prior authorizations. Most doctors also offer an optional membership for unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time, typically $25 to $100 a month.


## How to treat rosacea with AI: share your triggers and photos with a doctor


Start on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) , or from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, Meta Muse or Instinct at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) , or send your AI:


> ` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


Your AI can fill intake answers from what you already shared about triggers (sun, heat, spicy foods, alcohol) and gentle[skin care](https://www.aad.org/public/diseases/rosacea/triggers/tips) (fragrance-free cleansers and SPF 30+ mineral sunscreen), and you confirm the summary first. For[photos](https://www.aad.org/public/fad/digital-health/taking-pictures-skin) , the AAD advises removing makeup, using natural light without filters, and taking three focused shots.


Your doctor must be licensed in your state. FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. If you do not see your state, try anyway.


FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
